paper.title_en: A Non-local "Boundary" Term for Two-Point Amplitudes in String Field Theory
paper.abstract_en: We propose a new ``boundary'' term in free bosonic string field theory. With the original choice of energy operators, the term is non-local in time. We construct this term as a bilinear form involving the commutator of the BRST operator with the step-function operator. The resulting action restores cyclicity, as required for a variational principle. When evaluated on on-shell string fields, the proposed term reproduces the correct tree-level two-point amplitude for both open and closed strings. We verify this explicitly in the tachyon and massless sectors. An alternative off-shell choice yields a time-local boundary term with the same on-shell amplitudes. For the open-string tachyon, this yields an initial-data prescription.
